changeSet.author: mihai.jarda
changeSet.sql: UPDATE resources SET status = 'AVAILABLE' WHERE status = 'BOOKABLE' OR status IS NULL
ALTER TABLE resources ADD CONSTRAINT ck_resources_status CHECK (status IN ('AVAILABLE', 'MAINTENANCE', 'RESTRICTED'))
ALTER TABLE resources DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS uq_resources_name_per_floor
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS uq_resources_name_per_floor ON resources (floor_id, lower(name))

rollback.sql: ALTER TABLE resources DROP CONSTRAINT ck_resources_status
ALTER TABLE resources ADD CONSTRAINT uq_resources_name_per_floor UNIQUE (floor_id, name)
